description: This file contains helper functions for command-line interface parsing, processing repositories, and outputting various metrics related to bug localization and ranking evaluations in a software project.

methods.name: parse_cli_arguments
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for repository path, mode, iteration, and loop count, returning a namespace with these settings.

methods.name: process_repos
methods.description: Processes a list of repository paths to generate bug ranking data, optionally with GUI data, and tracks the best rankings.

methods.name: output_metrics_with_improvement
methods.description: Calculates and displays various ranking metrics and their improvement over baseline, including printing tables.

methods.name: output_metrics
methods.description: Outputs ranking metrics, saves to CSV, and displays tables for overall performance evaluation.

methods.name: output_big_metrics
methods.description: Appends ranking metrics to a CSV file for a specific loop iteration without detailed rankings.

methods.name: output_big_metrics_with_improvement
methods.description: Appends ranking metrics with improvement data to a CSV file for a specific loop iteration.
